title: Direct and Inverse Variation of p
subject: Mathematics
topic: Effect of changes in q and r on p
caption: Proportionality diagram illustrating how a 20 % increase in q and a 20 % decrease in r produce an 87.5 % increase in p.
altText: The diagram shows three circles labeled q, r, and p arranged left to right. Above each circle are the new values: q₁ = 1.2 q₀, r₁ = 0.8 r₀, p₁ = 1.875 p₀. Below each are the original values q₀, r₀, p₀. A straight arrow from q to p indicates direct proportionality, and a curved arrow from r to p indicates inverse proportionality with a square (1/r²). At the bottom, the formula p ∝ q / r² is displayed, along with the statement that a 20 % increase in q and a 20 % decrease in r lead to an 87.5 % increase in p.
